Verified: (1) premium lifetime plan for user 7e36ab22 (all 6 gates true, taskReminderCallsLimit=-1 nested under usage, planExpiresAt=2099-12-31), (2) reminders/settings GET+PUT with timezone field, (3) PUT reminders/settings triggers immediate scheduleRecurringForUser and enqueues meal reminders whose UTC scheduledFor maps EXACTLY to breakfast 08:00 / lunch 13:00 / dinner 20:00 America/New_York local time (also workout reminders enqueued), (4) POST /api/cron/reminders 401 without Bearer, 401 with wrong secret, 200 with correct 'suvio-cron-secret-dev' and NO user cookie (public secret-authed as designed), (5) AI Personal Trainer POST/GET/DELETE full CRUD with formScore, estimatedKcal, totalCorrectReps computed correctly and DB persistence verified, DELETE of bogus id returns 404, (6) POST /api/auth/phone/send returns { ok:true, devMode:true } as dev fallback (TWILIO_* not set), (7) Non-premium user (seeded temp free user) correctly gets 402 on meals/workout/water enable, (8) Code-verified: tools.js schedule_phone_call uses user.reminderSettings.timezone → preferences.timezone → 'Asia/Kolkata' fallback and formats with { timeZone: userTz }, (9) scheduler.js MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 with exponential backoff (5/15/60 min) and status stays 'pending' with nextRetryAt on retry, (10) workout page contains data-testid='ai-trainer-section'.
critical_code_review_comments: route.js is now ~1999 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline (flagged in iteration_1 & 2, no regression on this).

scheduler.js scheduleRecurringForUser water loop iterates minute-by-minute for the full 24h horizon (~1440 iterations) doing a DB findOne per matching slot. For many users this becomes O(users * hours * 60) DB queries. Recommend building candidate times in-memory first, then a single bulk findOne with $in on purposeKey.

PUT /api/reminders/settings replaces the entire reminderSettings doc with the request body via $set (line 1541). A client sending a partial payload (e.g. just {timezone,...}) can wipe unrelated sub-objects like taskFollowup. Consider deep-merging with existing settings or requiring the full object in the schema.

tools.js line 251 rejects 'when < Date.now() - 60_000' but the tool description asks the LLM to compute absolute ISO in the user's tz — no explicit rejection if the LLM passes a naive local timestamp without offset. Low-risk with the current gpt-4o-mini prompt but worth guarding.
runDueReminders processes serially (for-of with await) — a single slow placeVoiceCall stalls the whole batch. Consider Promise.allSettled with a small concurrency cap.
cron endpoint returns full `results` array which includes per-reminder reason strings — fine, but consider truncating for large batches.
